workflowInfo.workflowDescription: Purges all jobs from the JES2 spool that match a given owner and are in the Print Queue

variable.name: JOB_OWNER
variable.label: Job Owner
variable.abstract: Owner user ID to filter jobs for purging
variable.description: Only jobs whose owner matches this user ID will be purged. Defaults to ANDRE.

step.name: listJobs
step.title: List Matching Jobs
step.description: Uses SDSF ISFEXEC via TSO REXX to list all jobs owned by the specified user that are in the Print Queue, before any purge is performed.
step.instructions: This step lists all jobs on the spool owned by ${instance-JOB_OWNER} that are currently in the Print Queue. Review the list before proceeding to the purge step.

template.inlineTemplate:
/* REXX - List jobs in Print Queue for a given owner */ SIGNAL ON NOVALUE NAME HANDLE_ERROR
OWNER = '${instance-JOB_OWNER}'
X = ISFCALLS('ON') IF X <> 0 THEN DO SAY 'ISFCALLS ON failed, RC=' X EXIT 12 END
ISFPREFIX = '*' ISFOWNER = OWNER
SAY COPIES('=',72) SAY 'SPOOL JOB LIST - Owner:' OWNER ' Queue: Print' SAY COPIES('=',72) SAY LEFT('JOBNAME',10) LEFT('JOBID',10) LEFT('OWNER',10) LEFT('STATUS',10) 'PRTY' SAY COPIES('-',72)
ADDRESS SDSF "ISFEXEC ST" IF RC <> 0 THEN DO SAY 'ISFEXEC ST failed, RC=' RC EXIT 12 END
COUNT = 0 DO I = 1 TO JNAME.0 IF OWNERID.I <> OWNER THEN ITERATE IF QUEUE.I <> 'PRINT' THEN ITERATE SAY LEFT(JNAME.I,10) LEFT(JOBID.I,10) LEFT(OWNERID.I,10) LEFT(STATUS.I,10) JPRIO.I COUNT = COUNT + 1 END
SAY COPIES('-',72) SAY 'Jobs matching owner' OWNER 'in Print Queue:' COUNT SAY COPIES('=',72) X = ISFCALLS('OFF') EXIT 0
HANDLE_ERROR: SAY 'REXX NOVALUE error at line' SIGL EXIT 12

step.name: purgeJobs
step.title: Purge Matching Jobs
step.description: Uses SDSF ISFEXEC via TSO REXX to purge all jobs owned by the specified user that are in the Print Queue. Each job is actioned with ISFACT TYPE=PURGE.
step.instructions:
This step purges all jobs on the spool owned by ${instance-JOB_OWNER} that are in the Print Queue.
WARNING: This action is irreversible. All matching jobs and their spool output will be permanently deleted.
Review the job list from the previous step before completing this step.

template.inlineTemplate:
/* REXX - Purge all Print Queue jobs for a given owner via SDSF */ SIGNAL ON NOVALUE NAME HANDLE_ERROR
OWNER = '${instance-JOB_OWNER}'
X = ISFCALLS('ON') IF X <> 0 THEN DO SAY 'ISFCALLS ON failed, RC=' X EXIT 12 END
ISFPREFIX = '*' ISFOWNER = OWNER
SAY COPIES('=',72) SAY 'SPOOL PURGE - Owner:' OWNER ' Queue: Print' SAY COPIES('=',72)
ADDRESS SDSF "ISFEXEC ST" IF RC <> 0 THEN DO SAY 'ISFEXEC ST failed, RC=' RC EXIT 12 END
PURGED = 0 FAILED = 0 DO I = 1 TO JNAME.0 IF OWNERID.I <> OWNER THEN ITERATE IF QUEUE.I <> 'PRINT' THEN ITERATE
JOBNAME = JNAME.I JOBID = JOBID.I
ADDRESS SDSF "ISFACT ST TOKEN('"TOKEN.I"') PARM(NP P)" IF RC = 0 THEN DO SAY 'PURGED:' LEFT(JOBNAME,10) JOBID PURGED = PURGED + 1 END ELSE DO SAY 'FAILED:' LEFT(JOBNAME,10) JOBID ' RC=' RC FAILED = FAILED + 1 END END
SAY COPIES('-',72) SAY 'Purged:' PURGED ' Failed:' FAILED SAY COPIES('=',72)
X = ISFCALLS('OFF') IF FAILED > 0 THEN EXIT 8 EXIT 0
HANDLE_ERROR: SAY 'REXX NOVALUE error at line' SIGL EXIT 12
